cash_tip: No ATM outage reports this week, and more spots now take cards (Papá Omar and Jahgyro both do), so your pesos stretch further. When you do pull cash, use a bank ATM rather than a standalone machine, tap 'decline conversion' so you are charged in pesos, take out one larger amount, and keep small bills for tacos, taxis and the market.
